meta.title: Ceramic Coating, Tint & Detailing in Sterling Heights, MI
meta.description: Ceramic coating, window tint and paint correction at our shop, roughly 15 minutes from Sterling Heights. Mobile detailing in your driveway. Free quote.

hero.kicker: Ceramic coating, window tint and detailing in Sterling Heights, MI
hero.title: Next door. **Or in your driveway.**
hero.lede: Our shop on Louise Ave is about 7 miles from central Sterling Heights: Utica Road southeast to 14 Mile Road, then east. Coatings, tint and paint correction happen there. Detailing can come to your home or workplace, and valet pickup covers the rest.

about.title: What Sterling Heights does to a car.
body: Sterling Heights is laid out on the mile road grid, from 14 Mile Road at the south edge to Hall Road (M-59) at the north, with Mound and Van Dyke running north and south and Utica Road cutting across on the diagonal. It is a city of subdivisions, street trees and auto plants, with the Clinton River crossing its northeast side. Each of those shows up on a vehicle in a specific way.

points.title: Salt on the main roads, then your street
points.body: County plows and salt trucks start on the state and primary roads, and Van Dyke and Hall Road are both state routes. The city works its own streets the same way: major roads, then neighborhoods. The residue dries white on rocker panels and floor mats and keeps working on the finish until it is washed out, not just rinsed.

points.title: Street trees and overnight sprinklers
points.body: The city has been a Tree City USA for decades, and its stated goal is a street tree in front of every home. In summer it also asks homeowners to water lawns between 11pm and 5am. Park under the tree and the paint collects sap. Park in reach of the sprinklers and the water dries into spots by morning.

points.title: Parks and the Clinton River
points.body: Dodge Park has sports fields, a splash pad in summer and an ice rink in winter, and the Clinton River has public kayak and canoe launches at Rotary Park and North Clinton River Park. What rides home is grass, mud and wet gear. Getting it back out of the carpet takes steam and hot water extraction, which is interior detail work.

points.title: Trucks and three row SUVs
points.body: The Ram 1500 is built here, at Sterling Heights Assembly on Van Dyke. We work on full size trucks and three row SUVs as well as sedans, and the larger vehicles are quoted for their size.

points.title: Driveways that suit mobile work
points.body: Sterling Heights is mostly single family homes, and a house with a driveway is all a mobile detail needs: room to walk the full perimeter of the vehicle. We bring our own power and water. At an apartment or condo it comes down to the parking spot, and valet pickup covers it when there is no room.

logistics.title: Fifteen minutes to the shop, or we come to you.
body: The shop is about 7 miles from central Sterling Heights, roughly 15 minutes without traffic. From the middle and north of the city, take Utica Road southeast to 14 Mile Road and turn east. From the south end, 14 Mile Road east takes you the whole way. We are on the north side of 14 Mile, just east of Kelly Road.

Interior, exterior and full details can all be done in your driveway. Ceramic coating, window tint and paint correction need the shop, where we control light, dust and cure time. If you cannot spare the trip, valet pickup collects the vehicle and brings it back.

facts.label: Mobile detailing
facts.value: Yes, at your home or workplace

faq.q: Do you come to Sterling Heights for mobile detailing?
faq.a: Yes. Sterling Heights is one of the closest towns to our shop and well inside our mobile service area. We bring our own power and water. All we need is a driveway or parking spot with room to walk around the whole vehicle. See [how mobile and valet work](/mobile-detailing/).

faq.q: How far is your shop from Sterling Heights?
faq.a: About 7 miles from central Sterling Heights, roughly 15 minutes without traffic. From most of the city the simple way is Utica Road southeast to 14 Mile Road, then east. The shop is at 33115 Louise Ave in Clinton Township, on the north side of 14 Mile just east of Kelly Road. We are appointment only, so please book before you head over.

faq.q: Can you ceramic coat or tint my vehicle at my house?
faq.a: No. Coatings and window film need a controlled space: steady temperature, no dust and no wind. That work is done at the shop. If getting there is the problem, ask about valet pickup. On [ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating-sterling-heights-mi/) jobs, Uber is also covered for the drop-off and pickup.

faq.q: What does a detail cost for a truck or SUV?
faq.a: Package prices are listed for a coupe or sedan in average condition: interior details from $184.99, exterior details from $139.99 and full details from $249.99. Trucks and SUVs are quoted for their size, and we give you the number before any work starts. See [detailing in Sterling Heights](/car-detailing-sterling-heights-mi/).
